tei:div.tei:p: /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor lta ba'i mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/

gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ bde stong gnyis med rang bzhin lhan skyes chos kyi sku// ma 'gags glo bur rtog pas ma bslad rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs// bcu gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyin thub pa sprul pa'i sku// sku bzhi dbyer med bla ma dam pa rgyal gyur cig /'dir rang re 'bri gung pa'i phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid 'di la dang por go cha rnam pa gnyis te/ phyi lta ba'i go cha/ nang shes rab kyi go cha'o// de la sdig pa phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem zhing*/ dkar po'i chos spyod rgyun mi gcod pa phyi lta ba'i go cha/ rkyen ngan bogs su 'don zhing*/ sems gnas pa zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin byung ba la yon tan du mi lta/ ma byung ba skyon du mi lta ba nang shes rab kyi go cha/ de la spyi'i don la nges 'byung skyo shas dang 'brel pa thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi bsgom/ nyams rtogs yon tan dang 'brel pa dngos gzhi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dang zhi gnas bsgrub pa/ 'bras bu re dogs dang bral zhing 'brel pa bogs 'don rtsal sbyong ba dang bsngo ba'o// de yang mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba dang rnam pa gsum/ dang por sgom ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa la sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor/ skyes pa de nyid nyams su len par byed pa la ngo sprod rnam gnyis/ de bogs 'don par byed pa la nyams len snang thog nas skyong ba'i man ngag go// de la dang po skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed// dge bas byang chub sgrub par byed// zhes pa las/ blo nang du bzlog ste/ 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ srid par song ba thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad ni bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa rab tu zhi ba'o// zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ de'i don skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed/ ces bstan pa'i don 'di yin te/ 'jig rten chos brgyad la brten nas 'khor ba skyed pa'i dregs pa spong ba/

mi rtag pa ste yid skyo ba'i gang zag la rgyal srid kyi 'byor pas kyang bslu bar mi nus zhes pas skyo ba bskyed dgos so// de la sngar skyes pa rnams shi/ da skye ba rnams 'chi/ da lta yod pa rnams kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ sa 'am 'on te mtho ris su// gang zhig skyes nas ma shi ba// de ni mthong bar gyur pa'am// thos par gyur na the tshom za// zhes gang la yang snying po med par bsgom/ des na dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di thob kyang mi rtag pa ste/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bu don sgrub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na// phyis nas yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur// zhes pas/ thob par dka' zhing 'jig pa sla bar bsgom/ de ltar shi nas med mi 'gro ste/ las rgyu 'bras la 'jug ste/ 'dul ba lung las/ lus can kun gyi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// tshogs shing dus bab pa na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// zhes pas/ las dkar nag gi rjes su 'brang ba la bden pa bzhi'i don bsam/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung mi dge ba rgyu 'bras/ 'gog pa dang lam bden dge ba rgyu 'bras/ dang po ni mi dge ba spyad na ngan song gi las te/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// lha min 'thab dang rtsod pas nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes pas thar 'dod kyi blo bsgom par bya/ thar pa'i phan yon ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ lus kyi sgo nas rnam pa gsum// ngag gi sgo nas bzhi dag dang*// yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag dang*// chang mi 'thung dang 'tsho ba bzang*// rnam mi 'tshe dang gus sbyin dang*// mchod 'os mchod dang byams pas te// mdor na chos ni 'di yin no// chos 'dis ngan song gsum po dang*// sdug bsngal kun las yongs thar nas// bde bar rgyal srid 'thob par 'gyur// zhes pas/

'gog lam ste thar pa'i phan yon bsgom mo// de nas gong du dge bas byang chub bsgrub par byed// ces pa dang*/ sgom ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa la sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor/ de la lam log pa las skyob pa dkon mchog skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas yi ge brgya pa'i khrid/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs 'jug cing rtogs pa skye ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi'o// dang por 'khor ba las thar te thar pa sgrub pa'i thabs skyabs su 'gro ba las med de/ lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ srid pa gsum na rgyal ba dkon mchog gtso// de yi 'og tu de las byung ba'i chos// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyes chen brgyad po ste// srid gsum bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin pas// dngos grub 'dod pas gsang sngags mgo ru 'don// zhes so// rang nyid stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge dang rin po che pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan yangs shing rgya che ba la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams khrom tshogs su bzhugs par bsam/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du/ bla ma la 'dren pa zhu/ yi dam la rgyud byin gyis rlob pa zhu/ sangs rgyas la ston pa zhu/ chos la lam zhu/ dge 'dun la grogs zhu/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la dngos grub zhu/ chos skyong srung ma la bar chad zhi ba zhu snyam pa dang*/ ngag tu'ang brjod cing dad pa gsum sngon du 'gro bar byed/ de nas bdag gzhan thams cad mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// mi rtag pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/

rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin par byin gyis rlobs/ mos gus dam bca' brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ rten 'brel thabs la mkhas par byin gyis rlobs/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ bdag gi rgyud la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi rtogs pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ de nas tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim nas sems nyid ngal bso ba 'debs dang po'o// ༈ //sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas// lus ngag yid kyi nyes byas la// lus kyi dkyil 'khor mchod rten la// ngag ni yi ge brgya pa'o// sems ni sgyu ma'i don sgoms shig /ces pas/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje dkar po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar zla gdan la hūm̐ la yi ge brgya pas bskor ba la/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo sprul nas/ bde stong gi mchod pa phul bas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phog byin rlabs dang nus mthu bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa byung nas rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu'i dbyibs rgyud sku gang de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar dmigs nas/ bzlas pa'i skyon drug bral nas bzlas/ bar du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sogs sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs rnams dag par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ngas dag par bya'o// zhes gsung gi gnang ba sbyin par bsam/

de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ zhabs kyi mthe bong rgyud/ spyi gtsug tu bab nas lus la thim pas rang gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par dag bdud rtsis lus gang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur par bsams nas sngags bzlas/ thun gyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pas te// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs// zhes 'dod don du gsol ba btab nas rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bstim nas snang stong gi ngang la bzhag/ ༈ //tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la/ mdo sdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa des mi 'thob// ces so// de la sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang*/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gang yin yang*/ rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyan rin po che dang sman thum po la sogs la bya/ dang por maṇ+ḍal g.yon du bzung*/ rgyan g.yas su bzung nas phyi/ maṇ+ḍal rdul dang bral ba bzhin du/ sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag par bsams nas/ dbus su tshom bu gcig bkod/ seng ge dang gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du bla ma kun 'dus bzhugs par bsgom/ mdun du gdan bkod pa mchog dang ldan pa'i steng du yi dam lha tshogs/ g.yas su sangs rgyas dkon mchog rgyab tu chos dkon mchog g.yon du dge 'dun dkon mchog bar thams cad du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ 'khor yug la chos skyong srung ma rnams mngon sum du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas de yar bzhag la/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal sngar ltar byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ 'khor yug lcags ri ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las ri bo mchog rab/

shar lus 'phags po zla gam/ lho 'dzam bu gling sog kha/ nub ba lang spyod zlum po/ byang sgra mi snyan gru bzhi/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i grangs dang mnyam pa mngon par bkod nas/ bla ma yi dam bdag gi lus longs spyod maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar mdzad du gsol/ lha dkon mchog gsum/ dge rtsa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa 'bul lo// bzhes nas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar mdzad du gsol/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sa gzhi spos sogs dang*/ mi rtag pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sogs gong bzhin 'dod don la gsol ba btab nas/ tshogs rten rang la bstim nas sems bzo med du bzhag/ ༈ //bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug cing rtogs pa skye ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ dgyes rdor las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ gsang ba sngags las byung ba yi// drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de// spyi bo'i gtsug gam lag pa'i mthil// snying gi dbus su sus bsgoms pa// sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan kyang*// gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gnyis med sbas pa las/ yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// spyi bo'i bla ma legs mchod na// 'dod pa thams cad 'grub 'gyur te// bya ba mang pos ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu seng ge sngon po brgyad rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla bkod pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa mtshan dang dpe byad sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig tu bsgom/

de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas la sogs pa nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams spyan drangs/ bla ma dang gnyis su med par gyur nas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsams la phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod par bya ste/ phyi'i mchod pa dngos su bshams pa dang*/ yid kyis sprul pa rnams ltos med du 'bul/ nang gi mchod pa snying ga'i sa bon las bde stong gi lha mo lnga sprul nas mchod/ gsang ba'i mchod pa lha sku phyag rgya chen po mnyam bzhag gis mchod/ mos gus rab 'bring tha gsum gyis gsol ba gdab dgos te/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud las/ bka' drin mdzad pa rnam thar byin rlabs dang*// rnam pa cha lugs rjes su dran byas nas// dad mos gus shing shin tu gdungs pa yi// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa'i blos// yang dang yang du gsol ba drag tu btab// ces pas/ mos gus phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bla ma kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// yi dam kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// dam chos kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// dge 'dun kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// chos skyong srung ma kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs sogs/ gong gi skyabs 'gro 'dod don ltar gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po dang*/ mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po dang*/ thugs kha nas hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim gyis byung nas/

rang gi gnas gsum du rim gyis thim/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ de nas bla ma'i sku las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa byung*/ rang gi lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams su zhugs/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang nas/ dran pa ma yengs par 'jog ste/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor du// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /sa lam gyi rim pa ma lus rdzogs// zhes pa'i don no// de lta bu ma yin na/ ngan 'brel du 'gro nyen yod de/ man ngag rtsa ba las/ rje la gsol ba ma thebs shing*// zhen pa gting nas ma log na// sgom bzang yang nyung ma'i g.yos dang 'dra// zhes dang*/ gnad yig las/ brgyud ldan man ngag nyams rtogs 'dzoms// byin rlabs tshan g.yos rang 'dod zad// snying rje'i mdangs ldan de zhabs 'dud// gzhan du ltos pa ngan 'brel yin// zhes pas so// des na dngos gzhi skyes pa nyams su len pa la/ ngo sprod rnam gnyis dang*/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa las 'di lta ste/ snod ldan gyi gang zag gcig ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur nas/ smin pa grol bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sgom dgos te/ kyai rdo rje las/ brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom// spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas// spros pa nyid de spros med byed// ji ltar rmi lam sgyu ma dang*// ji ltar bar ma'i srid yin phyir// rtag tu 'di dag rnal 'byor pas// nyin dang mtshan du rnam par bsgom// zhes pas/ dang por spros bcas bsgom pa la/ jo mo lhan cig skyes ma'i bskyed rim bsgom dgos te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du bskyed rdzogs zab mo bsgom par bya snyam du kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de'i rjes su/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan/ de'i steng yi ge bam̐ smug nag las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs kyis nam mkha' la dar dmar po 'phyar ba ltar/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams khyab pa/ zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal khro zhal spyan gsum nyi ma dang zla ba ltar che zhing bsgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ steng zhal rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog pas khams gsum dbang du bsdus shing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa ban+dha khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing*/ zar bu rting pa'i bar du grol ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la rgyan zhing*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis rab tu mdzes pa/ me tog dmar po dang*/ sin+dhu ra dang*/ dril bu g.yer khas spras pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams can lo bcu drug lon pa/ gzhon zhing lang tsho dar la bab pa zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pas dbugs bral pho mo brdzis pa ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas la sogs pa nas/

bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ yid kyis mchod pa phul gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsgoms te/ lus bdag byin gyis brlabs pa/ rang gi lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo// snying gar haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor hrīṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ las tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha rnams su gyur/ ngag byin gyis rlabs pa snying po dang nye ba'i snying po bzlas te/ snying po ni oṃ gsum ma/ nye snying*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭ rnams bzlas/ bzlas pa la skyo na nyer bsdu byas nas thams cad bam̐ la thim/ bam̐ khog pa/ mgo bo zla tshes/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da skra'i rtse mo brgya stong du gyur nas/ ngo lta byed/ dran pa rgyag ro snyoms byed/ re dogs phral la bzhag go/ ༈ //da ni rdzogs rim la lta thog nas sgom skyong ba dang*/ sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba gnyis las/ da lan sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba ste/ zhi lhag bsgrub par bya ba ni/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas te// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces so// dang por bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ bzhag pa sems kyi gnad/ nyams len dus kyi gnad dang gsum las/ nyams len dus la bar mtshams med// dus kyi rgyal po dran pa'i tshe na bsgom// dus tshod nyid dang tshes grangs rtsi mi dgos// 'di la gza' skar tshes grangs med// 'di la snyung ba med ces bya// zhes pas dus rgyun du bsgom zhing*/

bca' ba lus kyi gnad ni/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las/ sgrub po bde ba'i stan 'dug ste// mig gnyis sna rtser gtad byas nas// sna ni lte ba'i tshad du bzhag /phrag gong mnyam la lce rkan sbyar// dbugs kyi 'byung rngub glod nas ni// cung zad cung zad rtsol bral bas// ji lta ba bzhin 'byung rngub ni// sems dpa'i dkyil krung legs gnas pas// zhes gsungs pas/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas te/ rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung gis mnyam gnas kyi rlung dbang du byed/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gis me mnyam gyi rlung dbang du byed/ sgal tshigs bsrang bas srog 'dzin gyi rlung dbang du byed/ mgrin pa gug pas gyen rgyu'i rlung dbang du byed/ dpung pa brgyangs pas khyab byed kyi rlung dbang du byed/ mig sna rtser gtad pas shes pa dbang du byed/ lus sems lug ril ltar bsgrims pas lus kyi gnad dbang du byed pa ste bdun no// bzhag pa sems kyi gnad la/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med gnyis las/ mtshan bcas bzhag thabs bdun te/ mtshan ma rdzas la brten pa'i dmigs pa bdun la/ shing bu dang rde'u/ sna rtse a'i gdams pa/ steng du bying ba sel ba'i thig le/ 'og tu 'thor ba bsdud pa'i thig le/ me tog dmar po la/ ston pa'i sku la/ rlung rjes 'gro brtag pa dang bdun no// mtshan ma med pa la brten pa ni/ dang por man ngag rtsa ba las/ rlung med rten can rten med gnyis// rten ni rde'u shing bu'am// mar me bla ma dag la gtad// rten med ma bcos ngang la bzhag /ces so// rang gi mdun du rde'u 'am shing bu phra'u zhig btsug nas mig cer te blta ste/ shes pa de thog tu lhan ne gtad cing*/ de la bsgrims nas rtsir zin du'ang mi byed/ de las yengs su yang mi gzhug sgom rgyu'i brtag dpyad mi byed par/ ma yengs mi sgom pa'i rten tsam du de la shes pa yud de gtad la/ lhod kyi glod nas tsen gyis 'jog

sgom dang bzang gyes byed pa gal che/ gnas byung na gang gnas la bzhag la/ thun bar du 'di yin med la shigs se ngal bso// de ltar thun chung la grangs mang bar bsgoms te/ pha dam pas/ rang rig ye shes sgom tsa na// thun chung ba la grangs mang bya// thun chung bas ni skyo mi dgos// grangs mang bsgoms pas skyon med 'thud// skyon med goms shing 'dris pa las// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ dmigs pa dang po'o// gnyis pa thun bar thams cad du de'i ngang ma shor bar dran pa rgyun chags su brten cing*/ mig gi sna rtser lta zhing 'gro 'chag la sogs pa'i spyod lam thams cad du/ nad pa'i spyod lam ltar dal bus 'gro dgos te/ mdo sdud pa las/ 'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan// gnya' shing gang tsam lta zhing 'gro la sems 'khrul med// ces dang*/ yang man ngag rtsa ba las/ gnas ni dben par mtshams bcad bya// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba btang*// spyod lam gnya' shing gang tsam lta// 'gro 'dug nad pa'i spyod pa bzhin// zhes so// dmigs pa gnyis pa'o// gsum pa thig le dkar po'i dmigs pa la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ ma rung thogs med dus nas rjes 'brel ba'i// sna tshogs yul la g.yo zhing 'phen pa na// myur du bkra ba'i shes pas bzlog byas na// rang gi dmigs rten la ni brtan por bzhag /ces gsungs pas/ bying rmugs sel ba/ rang gi rnam shes 'du ba'i gnas smin phrag tu thig le dkar po sran ma tsam la shes pa yud de gtad cing*/ sems gzhan du yengs su mi gzhug par de'i steng du gnas su gzhug gnas bdo ba la bshig cing ngal bso ba dang*/ thun bar thams cad du ngang ma shor ba'i spyod lam sngar bzhin no// dmigs pa bzhi pa rang gi 'khrul 'khor gyi 'og gdan gyi steng du thig le nag po lug ril tsam la shes pa gtad cing ma yengs bar bzhag go// 'dis ni 'phro rgod kyi skyon sel bar 'gyur ro// dmigs pa lnga pa mdun gyi nam mkhar me tog shar ma khad pa kha rang la bstan pa/

dmar po che ba zhig la ma yengs par 'jog gsal na gsal thog tu ma yengs pa mi gsal na mi gsal ba'i thog tu bzhag slar yang mi gsal na gsal 'debs te/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i ngo sprod las/ rmad byung nam mkha'i dkyil na bhū su ku// sna tshogs me tog skye 'o bhū su ku// me tog de ni kha dog sna lngar ldan// me tog de ni stong nyid dgon par skye// rin chen rin thang med pa'i me tog yin// zhes so// des dmigs pa brtan nas stong gzugs 'char ro// dmigs pa drug pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar gser btso ma lta bur bzhugs pa la/ dmigs pa ma yengs par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku 'di ni// 'jig rten gsum po kun nas snang bar byed// dmigs pa de la gang gi sems 'jug pa// byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam bzhag ces bya// zhes gsungs/ sems 'phro rgod ches nas brtan par ma nus na/ dmigs pa bdun pa rlung rjes 'gro rtog pa ste/ rlung 'gro na 'gro'o snyam du rtog 'jug na 'jug go snyam du rtog gnas na gnas so snyam du rtog gzhal ba ni dmigs par byed pa ste/ so sor rtog pa'ang de'o// dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa'i mdo las/ bgrang zhing gzhal la so sor rtog go// bgrang zhing gzhal la so sor rtog pas// lhag mthong rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'ang byed de/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'jug pa oṃ la gnas pa āḥ /ldang ba hūm̐ du shes par bya// zhes pas mtshan bcas kyi dmigs pa rnams song nas/ da ni mtshan ma med pa la bdun te/ rje btsun til+li pa'i chos drug las/ dang po mi bsam/ mi dpyad/ mi sems/ mi sgom/ mi dgag mi sgrub/ sems ni rang so nyid la bzhag ces pas/ lta stangs rten med pa'i nam mkha' la yid dmigs rlung gsum dus mnyam du sbyar te/ sbrang ma gar spyin la 'byar ba'am/

spang skam po la phur pa rgyab pa'am/ ba stod phur la rgyab pa ltar bya ste/ ci yang yid la mi bsam zhing*/ mi byed par 'jog pa ste/ grub pa sde bdun las/ mi bsam bsam med yul las 'das// bsam nas bsam med yul las 'das// mi bsam mi bsam bsam med yul las 'das// zhes pas/ dang por gzhi'i gnas tshul/ bar du rig pas gtan la phab nas ngo sprod pa/ tha ma lta bas thag bcad gzhi 'bras dbyer med do// gnyis pa mi dpyad ces pa/ 'jog sgom du byed de/ dpyad sgom spang ba'o// jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ chos dbyings spros dang bral ba la// shes pa'ang spros dang bral bar bzhag /ces gsungs/ gsum pa mi sems zhes pas/ sems ni sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o// 'od gsal ba gang yin pa de rnam par rtog pa med cing 'gyur ba med pa zhes rnam rtog mi sems par rang babs su bzhag /bzhi pa mi sgom zhes pa bsgom rgyu'i gtad so bral dgos te/ lho rin po che 'dzam gling grags pa'i ngo sprod bdun ma las/ gzhi'i blo la blo yis mi sgom par// rang babs la bzo yis ma slad pa// rtog pa la skyon du mi lta bar// mi rtog pa ched du ma sgrub dang*// sems rang sor zhog la rig pa'i rgyang so tshugs// sgom rtse gcig gi steng du phebs nas 'ong*// zhes pa ltar ro// lnga pa mi dgag zhes pa dgag sgrub mi bya ste/ rje btsun til+li pa'i phyag chen gaṅgā ma las/ sems la gtad so med na phyag rgya chen po yin// de la goms shing 'dris na bla med byang chub 'thob// ces so// drug pa mi bsgrub ces pa/ zhe 'dod dang bral bar bsgom ste/ yang gaṅgā ma las/ zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong sgribs// rtog pa'i bsrung sdom dam tshig don la nyams// yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral// rang byung rang zhi chu yi pa tra 'dra// mi gnas mi dmigs don la mi 'da' na// dam tshig mi 'da' mun pa'i sgron me yin// don 'dir gzhol na 'khor ba'i btson las thar// don 'dir mnyam gzhag bla med byang chub 'thob// bstan pa'i sgron me zhes su bshad pa yin// zhes so// bdun pa/

sems ni rang so nyid la bzhag ces pas/ so ma lhug pa rang dwangs/ ma bcos pa la bzhag pa'o// de la so ma zhes pa/ rtog pa snga ma 'das/ phyi ma ma shar ba'i bar lhug pa dgag sgrub med pa/ rang dwangs ma bcos pa'o// da ni gnas 'gyu 'byed par byed de/ de la dmigs pa yul la gtad pa/ 'gyu ba ar la gtad pa/ skyong byed rlung la gtad pa gsum las/ dang po nyi grib mtshams rdzas nag po'am sngon po la shes pa gtad nas bzhag pas/ kha dog dang sems gnyis gcig gam tha dad brtag par bya ste/ kha dog rang yin na ma ltas kyang rig dgos/ sems rang yin na kha dog med kyang rig dgos te/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig par ngo sprad de/ de bzhin du gnas 'gyu tha dad kyang 'gyu bas gnas pa'i go chod pa'i gnad rig par bya'o// des snang sems tha dad du 'byung ba yang shes dgos so// 'gyu ba ar la gtad pa ni/ kyai rdo rje las/ dri mas dri ma 'khrud par byed// rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dag /srid pas srid pa zad par byed// ces dang*/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ phu chu drag po rdab kyin brub// dngul dkar me long phyis kyin gsal// rnal 'byor sgom pa bshig na bzang*// zhes dang*/ sngar gyi gnas pa de cung zad bshig ste/ rtog pa 'phro ba de'i steng du/ dran thag ma chad par rtog pa ci mang du btang ste/ yul thog tu 'gyu ru bcug nas/ gcig skyes gnyis skyes skyes tshad ngos bzung zhing*/ ngos ma zin par 'og 'gyu ru ma song ba'i ngang nas spro/ de'i ngang nas cung zad ngal bso ba sogs gong bzhin no// des rtog pa de nyid sems 'dzin gyi rten du song nas/ rtog pa rbad de chad pa'i gnas pa mthug po 'byung*/ res 'ga' gnas 'gyu med cing ngos mi zin pa'i rtog pa bun long byed cing*/ rtog pa 'tshub par byung na khams kyi nus pa zad pa yin pas/ kha zas bcud can za zhing*/ khams sos nas sgom dgos te/ man ngag rtsa ba las/ dngos gzhi la ni rnam gnyis te// cha rkyen dang ni gdams pa'o// dang po kha zas bcud can bza'// lus zungs rgyas pas sems las rung*// zhes gsungs/

skabs su bka' brgyud kyi rnam thar dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud dang*/ skyo ba skye ba'i chos bshad bya ste/ yang man ngag rtsa ba las/ bar skabs sgrub brgyud rnam thar dang*// skyo ba skye ba'i man ngag bshad// ces gsungs/ skyong byed rlung la gtad pa ni/ rje btsun til+li pa'i zhal nas/ blo dman skyes bu don la mi gnas na// rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcun la bor// lta stangs dang ni sems 'dzin du ma yis// rig pa ngang gis mi gnas bar du gcun// zhes pa 'di la dang po bgrang ba dang dgang ba gnyis kyi rnam grangs la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rnam rtog lhag par dbugs 'byung rngub// brten pa rten pa nyer zhi ba// sems ni kun tu 'bar ba la// dmigs pa gcig la dam por bzhag /ces gsungs pas/ rlung srog rtsol phyi nang du rgyu ba la shes pa gtad nas/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang*/ nang du gnas pa'i bar la'ang*/ sems de nyid las gzhan pa'i mi rtog pa'i rang so ma shor bar bya'o// yang spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos/ rlung de gar 'gro sems der 'gro// des lus khyim nang btson bzung ste// yid kyi skyes bu bsad byas na// de med sems ni gang du 'gro// zhes dang*/ man ngag rtsa ba las/ dang po rtog pa bkag nas bsgom// de la rlung can rlung med gnyis// rlung ni ban bun thun bzhi bsgom// zhes rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas/ nang du 'jam la yun ring ba rngub cing lte 'og skyur nas/ rtog med kyi ngang la thub tshad gcig mnan cing*/ mi thub pa dang sangs te btang ste/ de ltar nyer gcig la sogs pa byed cing skabs su ngal bso/ gnyis pa rten med la/ sgrim lhod gnyis kyi dang po ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ sems rtse gcig pa med na ni// rnam par g.yeng ba'i go skabs su// gsang sngags thun 'jug min pa ste// de phyir ting 'dzin brtan par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni shes pa khrims kyis bsgrims nas/

mi rtog pa'i ngang la rtse gcig tu ma yengs par bzhag pa'o// sa ra has/ bcings pa dag ni phyogs bcur 'gro bar rtsom// btang bar gyur na g.yo med brtan por gnas// go zlog rnga mong lta bur bdag gis rtogs// bu khyod rnams kyang de ltar rang la cer gyis ltos// zhes gsungs pas/ sems rang lugs su lhod kyis glod nas/ ci yang mi sgom pa'i ngang nas ma yengs par cham gyis bzhag go// de rnams blo rigs tha dad kyi gnas pa'i skye tshul mi 'dra ste/ slob ma'i nyams dang bstun nas gnas 'gyu ngo sprod pa'o// nges nges khrigs khrigs su yod pa ma yin pas/ sgom gyi sna ma sun par gang zag gi blo rigs dang bstun nas 'khrid par bya'o// skyes pa nyams su len pa la ngo sprod rnam gnyis zhes pa zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ngo*// dang po ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas rnam rtog thams cad rang sar zhi nas/ sems rang lugs su gnas pa de zhi gnas yin te/ gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu gzhan yang mgyogs la rab tu mgyogs pa/ mi gnas par rgyu ba spre'u lta bu/ 'bab chu'i rgyun dang 'dra ba/ 'bru mar gyi mar me dang 'dra ba/ rgyang ring por 'gro ba/ lus med pa/ yul la brkam pa/ skye mched drug la spyod pa/ gzhan dang gzhan gyi shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems/ gnas pa rtse gcig pa/ mi 'phro ba/ zhi gnas la rtse gcig pa/ g.yeng ba med pa 'di ni sems gnas pa'o zhes gsungs/ dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug gis kyang*/ gnyis med lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i ro// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag ro gcig ltar// ji bzhin nyid du de bzhin gnas pa'i tshe// dmigs 'dzin zhen pa'i yid de rab tu zhi// zhes gsungs/ nyams rtogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba gnas pa las byung zhing*/ bsod nams dman pa thar pa la rgyab kyi phyogs pa kha cig zhi gnas 'gog cing lhag mthong dpyad pas thob par 'dod de/ dper na du ba bkag nas me sgrub par 'dod pa dag dang mtshungs so// 'dir ni zhi ma gnas na lhag mi mthong*// zhes pas bsgrub dgos te/

zhi gnas sam mnyam gzhag 'di gal che bar gsungs te/ dga' bo mngal gnas las/ gang la mnyam gzhag sems med na/ rnam dag ye shes med pas te// zag pa rnams ni spong mi nus// de bas khyod kyis nan tan bsgrub// zhes dang spyod 'jug las/ sems ni rnam par g.yeng ba'i mi// nyon mongs mche ba'i phrag na gnas// yul dang sems ni dben pa las// rnam par g.yeng ba mi 'byung ngo*// zhes dang*/ yab sras mjal ba las/ sangs rgyas chos rnams gang la yang*// lam gzhan dag gis mi mthong ste// zhi gnas ye shes che thob nas// rang byung nyid du nges par grol// ston pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi zhal nas/ zhi gnas sngon du 'gro zhes gsungs zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ shā ri'i bu de la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis sngon du 'gro na/ 'di lta ste/ sems nges par rtogs pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'o// zhi gnas sam bsam gtan la gnas te/ rnam rtog gi rgyun ma chad par 'od gsal ngo mi shes te/ kun rtog nye bar zhi ba'i thabs ni/ zhi gnas so// zhes dang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ blo rtog pa la skyon du mi lta zhing*// mi rtog pa ched du mi bsgom par// sems rang lugs su zhog la rgyang so tshugs// sgom zhi gnas kyi steng du phebs pa gcig 'ong gi// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar bsgoms pas bying rmugs la sogs kyi skyon sel ba ni man ngag rtsa ba las/ sgom skyon bying rmugs rgod dang gsum// bying na 'dug sa seng bar bya// chu thu ja dang bcas par brten// rgod na bsku mnye bcud can za// pho rlung drag po yang yang bsgom// rmugs na glo dkar ser bu brten// rten khyad par can gyi spyan snga ru// tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas// bla ma dkon mchog la sogs la// skur pa btab cing sdig bsags rnams// zhag bdun bar du bshags par bya// de nas yang ni skyar la bsgom// de ltar bsgoms pas nyams rtogs 'char// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa lhag mthong la gnyis te/

mnyam par bzhag pa dang ngo sprad pa'o// dang po mnyam par bzhag pa la/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ lta stangs rdzi ma khrab khreb mig 'bras la 'gyar 'gyur med par/ mdun gyi nam mkhar phan tshun gang la yang mi rten par thad kar hrig ge blta ste/ sa ra has/ mig mi btsum dang sgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor pas// zhes pas/ rig pa hur phyung ste/ ma yengs par dran pa yud de bya/ de'i ngang nas sems kyi ngo bo yod med bden rdzun ji 'dra zhig 'dug rang gis rang la thag chod cing*/ nges shes skyes par lta ste/ saṃ bhu ṭa las/ ma lus sdug bsngal tshang las sgrol 'dod cing*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bde ba 'god pa dag /sems ni rang bzhin yod dang med pa ni// brtan por byas nas 'bad de dpyad par bya// zhes pas/ dus kun tu btsal zhing rtog dpyod mi byed par mnyam par bzhag pa gal che ste/ rje mai tri pas/ chos kun khyab gdal chen po las// rang bzhin ma bcos rnal ma yin// bsam du med pa chos kyi dbyings// ma btsal bzhag na bsgom pa ste// btsal zhing bzhag na 'khrul pa'i blo// zhes gsungs pas/ mnyam gzhag gi sgom la nyams lta zhing grul thub bam tshad cing*/ rnam rtog la ngo lta byed de/ 'bri gung pa'i skyes sbyor las/ rnam par rtog pa la shes rab kyi mig gis bltas pas/ ma yengs pa'i dus su rnam par rtog pa ye mi 'byung*/ nam yengs pa'i dus su rnam par rtog pa zhig 'ong ste/ 'o na de spong ngam zhe na mi spong ste/ de nyid la yon tan can nam/ sku drin can nam/ med du mi rung bar blta ste/ ci zhe na rnam par rtog pa la brten nas shes rab kyi rtsal bskyed par 'dug pas/ rtog pa de spangs nas rtog med cig mi sgrub par/ de gang nas byung bltas pas/ rang gi sems nyid stong pa las logs su ma byung ste/ dper na nam mkha' stong pa la sprin byung ba lta bu'o// bar du ci 'dra zhig 'dug ltas pas/

ci'i ngo bo yang grub pa med de/ dper na rnam rtog ngo bos rang rang stong pa'o// tha ma gar song bltas pas logs su ma song ste/ dper na chu la lbu ba thim pa lta bu'o// de ltar rnam par rtog pa la skye med du dpyad cing bsgoms pas/ ci zhig ltar yang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems las logs su med snyam pa'i nyams 'byung ste/ nyams de bskyangs pas de yang dang po mtsho la kha ba babs pa lta bu 'byung*/ de bskyangs pas bar du nags la me mched pa lta bu 'byung*/ tha mar sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bu'i nyams 'byung*/ rnam par rtog pa de gang nas byung*/ gang du gnas/ gang du song blta mi dgos te/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i chos sku yin/ de'i rjes su 'phrad 'joms/ rjes snyeg med sprul/ re ba dgag dogs pa bsu/ zhe nas 'gyod pas zlog 'bri gung pa'i skyes sbyor don ma rtogs kyi bar ngo sprad na dred por 'gyur te/ gnad yig las/ snod bcud 'dzom pa'i gdams ngag la// nyams myong bzang po'i drod tshad dgos// tshar gcod rjes bzung rang sar bzhag /rnam gsum khrid kyi gnad yin no// gsungs te/ man ngag rtsa ba las kyang*/ ngo sprod ma snga rkun bur btang*// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang*// lta sgom dag dang 'brel ba gnyis// 'dzom na rtogs pa 'char ba ste// zhes gsungs pas bsgoms nas sa mtshams blta'o// gnyis pa ngo sprad pa ni/ zhi lhag ma nor ba dgos te/ slob dpon bha wa bha dra'i zhal nas/ chos nyid mi 'gyur rig pa ma slad pa'i// sems nyid mkha' ltar dag pa de la ltos// ma yengs yongs kyi bsgom pa gsal ba yin// zhi gnas rting po bsgoms pas 'tshang mi rgya// zhes pas/ sgom don la sems kyi rang bzhin de yod bya rgyu dang po gang gis kyang ma skyed/ ma byung bas skye med/ bar du phyi nang bar gsum gang du yang mi dmigs pas gnas pa med pa/

tha mar rkyen gang gis kyang bshig cing gzhom du med pas 'gag pa med pa dbang po gzugs can/ de la brten pa'i rnam shes thams cad kyi spyod yul las 'das shing*/ ston ka'i bar snang sprin dang bral ba ltar 'dug pa/ med bya rgyu gsal la ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa sing nge*/ rjen ne/ lhag ge hrig ge bar nyams su myong zhing nges shes skyes pa la thag gcod rgyu zhig 'dug pa/ yod med bden rdzun gyi phyogs dang bral zhing*/ rig thog tu mngon sum du nyams su myong ba de lhag mthong yin te/ chos thams cad kyi stong pa nyid mthong ba dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ mngon par 'du mi byed par mthong bas te/ blo gros mi zad par bstan pa'i mdo las/ lhag mthong zhes pa ni yod pa'i rnam par mi mthong*/ med pa'i rnam par mi mthong*/ skye ba dang 'jig pa'i rnam par mi mthong ngo*/ zhes pa'i don de nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'ang yin te/ byang chub sems pa'i sde snod las/ shā ri'i bu nga ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so// ji ltar 'od gsal zhe na/ rang bzhin gang yin pa de kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa ste nam mkha' lta bu'o// nam mkha'i rang bzhin no// nam mkha'i rjes su 'brang ngo*// zhes dang*/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ dri bcas rang rig ltos med phyir// rang byung ye shes de nyid te// rig pa'i phyir na gsal ba nyid// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes dang*/ mdo sdud pa las/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par bgyis// de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin// zhes gsungs/ rje til+li pas/ dper na nam mkha' stong par tha snyad rab brtags kyang*// nam mkha' la ni 'di 'dra brjod du med// de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang*// brjod pas 'di 'dra grub ces tha snyad gdags gzhi med// ces dang*/

bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ rang rig ye shes 'od gsal 'di// yod med mtha' las 'das pa zhig /rtag chad gnyis las 'das pa zhig /ngos zung med par gsal ba zhig /ye shes yin phyir skye 'jig bral// spros bral bde ba'i ngo bo can// dmigs pa'i yul med ngo bo gsal// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang spros bral phyag rgya chen po rang yin te/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyi yum la bstod pa las/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ pad+mo shrīs/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa 'di// bsam sgom blo yis ma bcos pa// chos sku gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// rang bcas yin no lhug par zhog /ces dang*/ bi na zhabs kyis/ sna tshogs thabs dang shes rab la// bla ma'i ngo sprod lnga yis grol// rig pa'i ye shes khong nas sad// bde chen lhan cig skyes par rtogs// zhes gsungs pas/ gshis kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa las/ rang rig pa'i ye shes zhes bya ste/ sa ra has/ sems nyid gdod nas dag pa la// rtog pas dri mas ma bslad cig /'di ni rang rig ye shes te// dag pa gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// zhes dang*/ til+li pas/ 'di ni rang rig sogs dang*/ nā ro pas/ rang rig bde gsal gyi shes pa 'di// ci yang med pa'i chos sku de// grub na zhe 'dod rigs pa la// grub pa med pa zhe 'dod ci// zhes dang*/ yang ḍā ki ma srid pa'i rgyal mos/ rang rig rgyal po 'di mthong na// thams cad thams cad thar pa'i lam// rang gi de nyid ma rtogs na// grol ba nam yang ma yin no// zhes gsungs shing*/ sems kyi yin lugs ni/ zhang rin po ches/ dri mas ma gos shel gong dag pa'i sems// rang rigs rang gsal mar me lta bu'i sems// rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub snying po'i sems// rgyun chad med pa chu bo lta bu'i sems// ngos zung med pa bar snang lta bu'i sems// phyi nang med pa ye shes zang thal sems// mkhar gzhong gtsang ma chu yis gang ba 'dra// zhes dang*/

yang dgon pas/ sems ngos bzung med pa stong pa'i dbyings// 'gag med du gsal ba rig pa'i sgo// blo bral gyi gsal stong rjen pa 'di// rang sar zhog la rang ngo ltos// sgom lhag mthong gi rang zhal mthong ba zhig 'ong gi// zhes gsungs/ 'dir 'phags pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin 'du ba'i dgongs 'grel las/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcos ldan 'das zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par 'phags pa du zhig sdud par bgyid pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' la bka' bstsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ji skad du/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par dpag tu med pa/ ji snyed bstan pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad 'dis bsdus par rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don go yul du ma lus par rang gis nyams su myong bar bya'o// da ni gzhung las de bogs 'don pa la nyams len snang thog tu skyong ba'i man ngag dang*/ bstan bshad bsdu ba gsum gyi don bsdus te bstan pa ni/ gang shar gyi ngo bo la ro snyoms byed de/ man ngag rtsa ba las/ skyon can mi spang srid du bcad// des na dgag sgrub gnyis dang bral// sna tshogs sgom du ma shar na// gang byas 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras yin// zhes so// de nas 'gyu byed kyi rtog pa gcig ched du spros te/ de nyid ma skyes la ma 'gag pa'i ngo bo la bltas nas/ gong gi spros med seng nge ba de dang khyad e 'dug thag chod nges shes skye nges su 'dug na de nyid skyong ste/ sha wa ris/ rlung ni mi bzung yid ni mi bcings par// ma bcos shes pa bu chung lta bur zhog /dran rtog byung na de nyid rang la ltos// zhes gsungs/ de ltar byas pas gsal stong blo bral gyi shes pa de nyid srid pa sna tshogs su langs shing*/ rtog pa'i ngo bo las spang sgyur phri mnan med par mnyam pa nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin chu dang rlabs lta bu ste/

bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ gang zhig sems las rnam spros pa// de srid mgon pa'i rang bzhin te// chu dang rlabs dag gzhan yin nam// srid zhi mnyam nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin no// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ gaṅgā la sogs chu klung sna tshogs pa// ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar// btags pa'i sems dang sems byung sna tshogs kun// chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig shes par byos// zhes dang*/ mai tri pas/ rtog pa rang grol phyag rgya che// gnyis med mnyam pa chos kyi sku// chu bo chen po'i rgyun 'bab ltar// gang ltar gnas kyang don dang ldan// zhes dang*/ dri med sems nyid me long rtsa bral la// skye med sgom pas ci zhig bya// rang byung rang shar rang grol la// rtog pa spangs pas ci zhig bya// dper na rtsa dang me 'thab bzhin// thams cad me yi rang bzhin ltar// nyon mongs rnam rtog gang de nyid// shes rab ye shes rang bzhin no// zhes dang*/ kha rag sgom chung pa'i zhal nas// nyams chung bdag la rkyen ngan gnod pa mang*// zhes sogs dang blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ ji lta ji ltar me ni ji snyed pa// de lta de ltar me ni stobs 'phel phyir// ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs srid// de ltar de ltar shes rab me rab 'phel// zhes dang*/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ kun snang ye shes cir mi rtog /nam mkha' dri med mkha' khyab stong*// sna tshogs ye shes me 'bar sku// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes dang*// mai tri pas/ dge dang sdig pa'i las rnams kun// de nyid shes pas grol bar 'gyur// nyon mongs ye shes chen po ste// nags la me bzhin rnal 'byor grogs// zhes dang*/ de lta bu'i man ngag dang ldan na 'khor bar 'ching byed 'dod chags la sogs pa de'ang rang bzhin med par rtogs pas/ nyes pa thams cad bral ba'i byang chub 'thob// ces dang*/ ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud las/

dper na rlung gis mar me 'jig pa'i rgyu// de bzhin nags tshal sreg pa'i grogs su 'gyur// de bzhin 'dod chags la sogs bde ba'i yul// dug lnga'i dgra rnams bcom nas gnyis med 'thob// zhes dang*/ yang dpe med par bstod pa las/ bag chags gzhir gyur mthar thug pa'i// khyod kyi nyon mongs sdig pa spangs// nyon mongs nyid kyi rang bzhin de// khyod kyis bdud rtsi nyid du bsgrubs// zhes dang*/ yang chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'dod chags dmigs med de bzhin zhe sdang dang*// gti mug 'di la nam yang dmigs med de// chos rnams kun kyang nam mkha' 'dra'o zhes// de ltar gang shes de ni rgyal bar 'gyur// zhes so// ldog bsgom ni dgyes rdor las/ gang gis 'jig rten 'ching gyur pa// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// chags pas 'jig rten 'ching gyur pa// 'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur// log pa'i sgom pa 'di nyid ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ ji ltar me yis tshig pa la// me nyid kyis ni gdung bar byed// ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa// chu gzhan dag gis rgyug par byed// ji ltar rlung gis zin pa las// mon sran rde'u'i bza' byin la// bzlog pa'i skyon ni btags pa las// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes// zhes pas/ dper na skyes pa rkyal mkhas pa// rkyal pa rtswa sogs kyis brgyangs te// pha rol rtswa dor 'gro ba bzhin// 'khor ba'i chu klung brgal 'dod pas// chos de dge ba'i rtog pa dang*// mi dge ba yi rtog pa kun// grogs su shes shing ro mnyam pa'o// saṃ bhu ṭa las/ dper na chu yis gang ba'i klung*// brgal 'dod skye bos shing dang ni// rtswa sogs bsdus te 'jus nas su// rkyal te pha rol brgal ba na// dor nas bde bar 'gro bar 'gyur// de bzhin chos dang chos min las// brten nas 'khor ba'i pha rol 'gro// bde ba'i byang chub thob gyur nas// chos dang chos min rab tu spong*// zhes pa'i don/

bla ma gdams ngag che/ slob ma shes rab che nas gsar du rtogs pa ma yin te/ gdod nas rtogs rung ma rtogs rung*/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i ngang*/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum byed pa ste/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ dus rnams kun tu thogs med par// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la// 'byung zhing 'jug la gnas par mdzad// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes dang*/ dpal phag mo gru pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs kyi rba rlabs yin// chos sku spros dang bral ba de// rnam rtog ma rig mun pa yin// ye shes rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor de// nyon mongs dug gsum 'bar ba yin// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho de// mya ngan 'das pa'i khang bzang yin// rnam rtog gzung 'dzin rba rlabs de// dus gsum 'gyur med kyi sangs rgyas yin// zhes gsungs/ zhang rin po ches kyang*/ rang rig dri med stong pa 'od re gsal// gzhi med cir yang 'char bas rgod re bro// gang shar dbyings las ma g.yos blo re bde// nyams myong bdud rtsis tshim pas kha re ngoms// spros bral nang nas shar bas sems re gtsang*// rig pa'i mdzod la dbang byed zhe re phyug /snang grags chos skur shar bas a re skyid// ces gsungs/ yang de nyid las/ rtog pa bkag pa'i mi rtog pa// de nyid rnam rtog 'khrul pa ste// chos sku sgrib pa'i mun chen yin// rtog pa 'phro bar mi 'dod gang*// mi rtog gnas par 'dod pa yis// zhe 'dod 'gong po phugs su bcug /gnyug ma'i dkor mdzod zad par byed// rnam rtog dgag pa'i sgom chen de// mar 'dod chu la bsrubs pa bzhin// bskal par bsgom kyang don mi mthong*// de phyir rnam rtog dgag mi dgos// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang rje yang dgon pas/ blo rtog pa ru 'gyu ba gnas lugs kyi sgo// rang ngo shes pa nyams len gyi gnad// rang zhal dang mjal bas rang grol yin// rang min gyi dran rtog 'dug gam ltos dang*// sgom gnas 'gyu'i bar lag phyed pa cig 'ong gi// zhes gsungs/

rnam rtog chos skur ngo sprod/ snang ba chos sku yin tshul/ rje 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi/ snang ba rang sems su rgyas par blta zhing*/ bye brag tu gnad yig las/ chig rkya pher nas ri khrod 'grim// snang rkyen thub nas spyod pa bya// yon tan rdzogs nas gzhan don bya// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'thob par nges// zhes gsungs/ yul nges can ka ba'am bum pa/ nges med gcig la cer te bltas nas glod bzhag pas/ dang po yul de'i spu ris lam me gsal zhing*/ cung zad nas blta snying mi 'dod pa'i zhen pa rang log tu 'byung zhing*/ de nas cung zad song nas snang la 'dzin med ting nge ba rang sar log pa bya ba zhig 'byung zhing*/ de'i dus su snang ba de 'gag nas 'gro'am/ rang dang snang ba gnyis tha dad du 'dug gam/ snang ba sems la tshur 'char ram/ sems kyi snang ba la phar la gzung ngam/ snang ba dang sems dbyer med par yul med stong snang du lhag ge 'dug gam/ legs par dpyad de/ rje yang dgon pas/ sgo lnga yul thog tu shar ba 'gag med kyi rtsal// yul 'dzin rkyen las skyes pa skye med kyi gshis// rang shar rang grol gyi brjod dang bral// snang zhen ma bkag par log pa rang bab kyi bsgom// stong snang blo bral du shar ba de rang grol gyi lam// snang ba la skyon du ma lta 'dzin pa thong*// sgom ro gcig gi klong du phebs nas 'ongs// zhes gsungs pas/ snang la 'dzin med du shes pa yul med du ldang ba de dang*/ sems rang sangs 'gag med/ snang sems dbyer med de lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin te/ lhan cig skyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa yin// zhes gsungs/ ye shes skyong gis/ kye ho snang stong dbyer med lhan cig skyes// rig stong dbyer med lhan cig skyes// gnyis med ye shes lhan cig skyes// rgyu 'bras dbyer med lhan cig skyes// 'di la tha dad ngas ma mthong*// zhes dang*/

nyi ma sbas pas/ yul la bltas pas skye ba med// sems la ltas pas spros dang bral// gnyis med don de blo las 'das// ngas ni ci yang ma mthong ngo*// zhes dang*/ sa ra has/ ji ltar dngos dang dngos med snang stong dang*// rgyu dang mi rgyu g.yo dang mi g.yo ba// thams cad lus med nam mkha'i rang bzhin las// dus rnams kun tu nam yang g.yo ba med// snang grags thams cad sgyu ma smig rgyu dang*// gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs dngos po mtshan ma med// sgyu mar snang mkhan sems nyid nam mkha' ste// mtha' bral dbus med sus kyang shes mi 'gyur// kun rdzob yul snang thams cad rang gi sems// rtog pa'i bag chags mthu brtas snang ba yin// zhes dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ 'jig rten rgyu rkyen las byung ba// rnal 'byor pas ni mi rtog ste// 'jig rten rang gi rtog pas rtog /sna tshogs bag chags dag las byung*// bag chags kyis ni dkrug pa'i sems// don du snang ba rang du snang*// don yod ma yin sems nyid de// phyi rol don mthong log pas te// sems ni sna tshogs nyid du snang*// zhes pas/ yul dang dbang po'i bye brag ni// gzugs sogs dngos por snang ba rnams// sems las phyi rol gyur med kyang*// sems nyid kho na snang bas so// zhes rigs drug bag chags mthun pa rnams la las gcig tu 'ong zhing*/ so sor bsags pa rnams las skye zhing chu'i dpe dang mtshungs pas mthong snang tha dad do// tshig bsdus las/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// lha mi lha min rigs drug la// dngos gcig yid ni tha dad pas// don ma grub par 'dod pa yin// zhes dang*/ kyai rdo rje las/ nga las 'gro ba thams cad 'byung*// zhes sogs dang*/ snang sems gnyis su tha dad med par song ba ma yin te/ ye nas dbyer med du gnas kyang*/ yul 'dzin gyis bsgribs nas ngo ma shes la/ da lta bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pas rgyu med stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'o// bir+wa pas/

ji ltar snang zhing srid pa'i kun rdzob chos can rnams// ngo bo nyid med ming tsam sgra tsam brda tsam ste// ming dang don la khyad par cung zad med// gdod nas lhan cig skyes pas gzhan nas btsal du med// zhes dang*/ mai tri pas/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems// phyi rol don mthong 'khrul pa'i blo// rmi lam bzhin du ngo bos stong*// zhes dang*/ lus ngag bcos shing bsgom du med// mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag med// 'di la gang yang ma grub ste// snang ba rang grol chos kyi dbyings// zhes dang*/ chos rnams rang rang ngo bos stong*// stong par 'dzin blo rang sar dag /blo bral yid la byar med pa// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// zhes gsungs/ snang tshul la sems can la nyon mongs pa ma dag pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor pa la ting nge 'dzin nyams kyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa la mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo dag pa'i snang ba ste/ shes rgyud gcig po de nyid rkyen ltos kyi dag mi dag so sor snang ste/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ rang bzhin dag cing bdag med pa'i// chos kyi dbyings ni spros dang bral// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul ni// rang byung dag pa 'char ba yin// rnal 'byor rnams la dngos grub kyi// 'bras bu nyams snang sna tshogs pa'o// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'byung*// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis// phrin las dag pa'i stobs su 'char// de nyid gzhan du mi rnyed de// shes rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa'i phyir// 'brel pa can du brjod par bya// zhes gsungs/ snang ba thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang stong gnyis med du rtogs pas/ dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa las bzlog ste/ ljon pas zhus pa las/ me long bzhin du yongs dag la// ji ltar rang bzhin med pa yi// gzugs brnyan snang ba de bzhin du// ljon pas chos rnams shes par gyis// zhes pas/

shel gong za 'og gi steng du bzhag pa ltar/ tha dad du snang yang snang sems gcig par rtogs dgos so// dpal phag mo gru pas/ snang ba sems su shes pa 'di// phyi yi sgro 'dogs chod pa yin// sems nyid dngos por ma grub pa// nang gi sgro 'dogs chod pa yin// phyi nang med par rtogs tsa na// lta ba'i sgro 'dogs chod pa yin// bun ne long nge 'dug tsa na// nyams myong sgro 'dogs chod pa yin// zhes dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ rig pa snang ba sku gsum lhag mthong yin// ma rig snang ba rigs drug las snang yin// 'khor 'das gnyis med mnyam mtshungs phyir// 'gag med ye shes rtsal sbyang bya// zhes so// da ni bogs 'don zhing rtsal sbyang ba ni/ gnad yig las/ 'khrul 'khor lta stangs kun la gces// sgom pa dus ltos dgos mi sleb// spyod pa ma 'dres yengs mi thub// goms pa chung na rkyen khar 'chor// zhes pas/ rgyun ma chad par ma bsgoms na gol te// man ngag rtsa ba las// de nas rjes kyi gdams ngag la// sgom skyes bdag po med pa ste// phyug po rlung gis khyer ba 'dra// yid bzhin nor bu 'dam gseb bying*// seng ge khyi yi zla la shor// rgyal po dmangs su babs pa yin// des na zhen log bdag po dgos// zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa yin// zhes so// yang ār+ya de was/ sgrub po dang po 'khor ba thog ma med pa can gyi sdug bsngal dran par byas nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dge ba 'dod pa'i phyir 'du 'dzi spang bar bya ste/ tha na rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la yang sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// gnyis pa til 'bru tsam la yang dngos por 'dzin pa'i blo spang bar bya'o// gsum pa ni don dam pa'i bden pa la mngon par dad pas lus dang srog la yang ltos pa med par bya'o// de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi dngos grub phra mo dang*/ grub pa chen po brgyad la yang don du gnyer bar mi bya// zhes dang*/

bir+wa pas/ 'dren pa gzhan la mi ltos gdengs chen thob gyur kyang*// bka' drin can gyi bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu khur// zhes gsungs/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ngang la mnyam rjes kun tu ma yengs pa'i dran pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du mthud pas yeng ba med cing spyod lam thams cad du bsres nas nyams su blangs te/ sha ba ris/ phyi nang thams cad lhan cig skyes// rtag tu gnas pa'i don de la// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnas par bya// bla ma nyid kyang mnyam bzhag las// slob ma byin gyis brlab par bya// thun gyi nges pa yod min te// ci tsam gnas kyi bar du bzhag /ces dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ lhan cig skyes pa spros bral phyir// bsgom par bya ba ma yin te// rang bzhin dmigs pa med pa'i spyod// rgyun chad par ni mi bya'o// zhes dang*/ ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud las/ bza' ba nyal ba 'chag pa kun// rnal 'byor chen pos gnas par bya// g.yeng bas g.yeng ba spong ba ni// bhū su ku yi spyod pa'o// zhes gsungs/ gnas na ched du mi spro zhing*/ rang bzhin shes pa'i ngang nas ji tsam gnas kyi bar du zhog 'phro na ched du gnas su mi 'jug par/ gang 'phros kyi rang bzhin du glod nas skyong ste/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ bya rog gzings la brten pa ni// ro mchog 'o ma 'thung ba yin// mtsho dang mtha' min rten la bzlog /lus kyi 'byung ba che rang la// yid la yid ni rab 'phros te// thams cad blo bur rang bzhin nyid// ces dang*/ shan ti pas/ gnas na zhog la 'phro na thong*// gnyis ka ma byed yan du chug /ched du gang 'dzin 'khrul pa yin// gzings nas 'phur ba'i bya rog ltos// zhes gsungs/ mnyam rjes thams cad bzo med byung rgyal du bskyangs pas/ snang thog tu ngos zin tshad yul med stong snang du lhang lhang 'byung zhing*/ rtog thog tu ngos zin tshad gsal stong rang rig tu rjen rjen 'char te/

mai tri pas/ mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag ces// 'di la gang yang ma grub ste// snang ba rang grol chos kyi dbyings// rtog pa rang grol phyag rgya che// gnyis med mnyam pa chos kyi sku// chu bo chen po'i rgyun 'bab ltar// gang ltar bltas kyang don dang ldan// 'di ni rtag tu sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pas/ ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa ma thob bar du thabs gtso bor mi sgrub cing*/ rtse gcig par nyams su len/ brtan pa thob nas chos thams cad blang dor med par bsgrub par bya ste/ ār+ya de was/ gsang sngags bsgom par mi bya zhing*// phyag rgya bcing pa'ang de bzhin te// gsang sngags bzlas par mi bya'o// byed na gzugs brnyan bzhin du ni// rang gi sems nyid mthong bas bya// zhes gsungs/ glang po rtsal las/ thams cad mkhyen pa bla med pa// sangs rgyas ye shes thob 'dod pas// chos rnams gang yang mi len zhing*// chos rnams gang yang mi 'dor ro// zhes gsungs/ da ni rtsal sbyong bya ba las/ rtogs pa kha tshom had po de// rang rtogs par rlom kyang shes bya'i sgrib pa yin// rang ngo ma shes gnas pa nyog po de// rang rtogs par rlom kyang las kyi sgrib pa yin// rang ngo ma shes mi rtog hur po de// rang rtogs par rlom kyang nyon mongs sgrib pa yin// kye ma skyon med mtha' ru skyol ba dka'// skyel rgyu drung nas bud pa'i rnal 'byor bde// gnyis 'dzin byung bas chog pa'i rnal 'byor skyid// dka' dka' 'dra yang sla bar yod// ces pas/ ro snyoms su rtsal sbyong*/ da ni sor bzhag bya ste/ don la bya rgyu mi 'dug pas/ mi lta mi sgom/ ci yang mi byed pa 'di la 'bad/ yab yob kyis gdon la ma skur/ smra mang gi rlung la mi 'char/ bya byed kyi dug la mi 'thung*/ bya rgyu la 'di las med bsam pa byas la rgyun du skyong ngo*// byar med ma brjed tsam min par/ bya rgyu med par byas pas mi 'ching ngo*// rtsal sbyong rdzogs pa la/

'ching ba kun kyang grogs yin no// ngo bo byar med byas kyang rdo rje'i glu 'di yin// byar med yengs med 'bral med dang*// 'bral med byar med dang 'dres med// byar med brjod med byar med dang*// byar med byar med 'gyur med sogs// rtsal sbyong ma rdzogs 'ching ba'ang srid cing sa chod par dka'o// dbang po rnon po la 'di mi dgos rtsal sbyong rang gi chog sor bzhag ces bya ba'i snying gtam mo// da ni 'phrang sgrol bya ste/ rang nyid lha ru mthong ba'i 'phrang sgrol bar byed pa khrid 'di skyongs/ rang 'chor dang rang 'dod ni lha ru mthong ba'i 'phrang sgrol bar byed pa la 'di tsho'i skabs su dran pas zin par bya ste/ khyad par nga rgyal dang rang bstod smra ba'i dus sogs chos brgyad skyes pa'i dus du dge sbyor 'chor ba'i 'phrang yin pas rgyun du 'bad pa gal che dgos te/ yum las/ bsam gtan gyis rlom sems su mi byed do// zhes dang sdud pa las/ bdag ni mnyam par bzhag ce'am langs zhes rlom sems med// ci phyir zhe na chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes phyir// zhes dang*/ sgom don rdzogs nas/ da ni gzhung las/ sgom thog nas lta ba btsal bya bas/ sgom don de smra bsam shes brjod las 'das pa lta ba'i ngo bo de mthar thug lta ba ste/ blo 'das su ngo sprad nas bskyang bar bya ste/ gang byung de ka nyams len gyi ngo bo yin mod/ de min ci byed kho rang de ka 'dun pa'i ngo bo yin mod/ de min 'dun pas ci byed/ kho rang gang 'dug pa de ka ngo sprod yin mod/ de min ngo ci sprod/ gang shar de ka yin mod/ gzhan ci byed/ de ka dge sbyor gyi ngo bo yin mod/ de ka sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo dang thugs dgongs yin te/ dge sbyor kho rang*/ ngo sprod kho rang*/ dran pa kho rang*/ 'dun pa kho rang*/ gang byung 'di las bya rgyu gda' ye/ bde na yang bde ba yin mod/ gsal na yang gsal ba rang yin mod/

des 'gre ste/ mtha' med 'di a na u tshugs lta bu phal gyi blo ru mi shong yang*/ rigs pas thob cing mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag nges don 'khrul med du ston pa rnams kyi dgongs pa'o// rigs pas 'thob na ci lta bu zhe na/ 'o na de ka min pa gzhan ci byed/ ji ltar yod pa de las 'gyur mi srid de/ rang gi rang bzhin mi 'dor ba'i phyir ro// 'dus ma byas rnams ni nam yang 'gyur mi srid la/ 'dus byas rnams kyang don dam par ma grub pa'o// zhes rnam mkhyen gyi bar du gsungs pas so// gzhi lta ba'i mthar thug ci lta bu zhe na/ snang ba snang ba'i ngo bos stong*/ stong pa stong pa'i ngo bos stong*/ yod pa yod pa'i ngo bos stong*/ med pa med pa'i ngo bos stong*/ sogs des 'gre'o// 'di ni nyams len/ ngo sprod/ bogs 'don/ rtsal sbyong*/ bzlog bsgom/ sor bzhag 'phrang sgrol ma thob pa la dpe yang mi bstan par gsang bar bya'o// gdams pa ston pa'i tshad ni 'di rnams dang gnas lugs rtogs shing lta ba'i gdengs thob nas/ slob ma snod ldan la smra ba ma gtogs/ de las gzhan du smras na nyes chen du 'gyur te/ bir+wa pas/ chos nyid mtha' bral zangs thal chen po'i don rtogs kyang*// brtan pa ma thob bar du nyams myong gzhan la gsang*// zhes dang*/ nges brjod bla ma las/ bdag byin gyis rlobs pa'i cho ga 'di// sangs rgyas mu stegs can la gsang*// zhes dang*/ kyai rdo rje las/ ma gsang sbru+ul dang chom rkun dang*// sa spyod mi yi sdug bsngal 'byung*// zhes dang*/ ye shes grub pa las/ glegs bam tsam zhig bstan pa yang*// sbyin mi bya bar shes bya ste// rdo rje ye shes rab spong bas// rmongs pa dmyal bar 'gro bar nges// de yang dmyal ba'i rgyur gyur pa// mi des mnar med 'thob par 'gyur// de bas bdag gzhan phung bar ni// 'byung bar 'gyur bas bsrung bar bya// gzhan du ston par 'gyur ba ni// dam tshig dag ni nyams par 'gyur// zhes pas gsang bar bya'o// gzhan yang lta ba lha med 'dre med du rtogs shing rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang*/

rtsa ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mi spong ste/ bram ze chen po sa ra has/ rgyal ba mai tri pa la gdams ngag gi gnad bcu dgu'i sgo nas gnang ba ni/ snang ba sems su shes kyang 'dus byas kyi dge ba rgyun ma gcod/ rang sems sangs rgyas su shes kyang rtsa ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mi spang*/ yar sangs rgyas la re ba med kyang dam pa'i chos la skur pa mi 'debs/ mar ngan song la dogs pa med kyang sdig pa phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem/ yi dwags la dogs pa med kyang sbyin pa gtong ba rgyun ma gcod/ byol song du skye ba'i dogs pa med kyang lus ngag yid gsum sdom pa bsrung*/ lha dang 'dre med pa'i don rtogs kyang yi dam gyi lha ma spangs shig skye ba med pa'i don rtogs kyang*/ 'gro ba'i lus rten la goms par gyis shig 'khor 'das rang grol la song kyang*/ dkar po'i chos spyod rgyun ma bcad cig mnyam nyid kyi don rtogs kyang 'gro ba phal pa sun ma 'byin cig snang grags thams cad chos skur rtogs kyang rang sems la nan tan bskyed cig thams cad sems su shes kyang sems can phra ba'i srog ma bcad cig gnyug ma'i ngang dang ma bral yang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa srungs shig rnam par rtog med kyi lta ba rtogs kyang*/ phyogs ris med pa'i lta ba la nan tan bskyed cig yengs pa med pa'i sgom pa yod kyang*/ 'dzin chags med pa la nan tan bskyed cig nyam nga med pa'i spyod pa byung yang 'gro ba dang mthun pa'i spyod pa gyis shig zol zog med pa'i dam tshig rtogs kyang rang sems dpang por tshugs shig rig pa byang chub kyi sems la skye shi med kyang 'dus byas kyi phung po 'di mi rtag par sgoms shig rang la rig pa'i klong rdol yang*/ bla ma dam pa spyi bor khur cig ces pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang stong nyid rgyu 'bras su ma rtogs pa'i stong lta had po'i gol sa phyed dgos te/ de ci lta bu zhe na/ las rgyu 'bras kun rdzob tu yod pa'i 'gegs pa dang*/

med pa'i phyogs 'ba' zhig la zhen pa dang*/ zab mo'i chos ma rtogs par tshig tha snyad la zhen pa rnams te/ dus 'khor rgyud phyi mar/ sangs rgyas bya ba de spangs na ni bde snyam dang bral stong pa 'ba' zhig sgom byed pa// de yis bskal pa du ma rnams kyis sangs rgyas nyid dang lhan skyes bde ba dag kyang ring*// zhes dang*/ don dam snye mar/ shes rab la zhugs snying rje rnam par spangs pa ni// rin chen sems rtogs pa'ang de mi gnas// zhes dang*/ de la sogs pa'i gol sa gsum dang*/ shor sa bzhi ru ma shor bar nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu mchog sku bzhi rtags brgyad dang grub pa chen po brgyad la sogs 'thob par 'gyur te/ bram ze chen do ha las/ smon lam snying rje'i dbang gis gzugs sku gnyis po 'byung ba dang*// bum pa bzang po dpag bsam shing dang nor bu bzhin// gdul bya rnams la blo gros pa yi blo 'byung ste// de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi rnam par 'phrul pas te// zhes gsungs/ thun bar dang mjug tu bsngo bas rgyas 'debs dgos te/ mdo sdud las/ de las langs nas gos pa med pa'i chos spyod cing*// de yang 'gro ba'i don du byang chub rgyur bsngo na// bsod nams 'di dang mnyam pa 'jig rten gsum na med// ces gsungs/ de rnams kyi tshar chos ni/ man ngag rtsa ba las/ mdo rgyud bla ma'i gsung sgros dang*// ngo sprod thams cad rdzogs par ni// rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa bshad// 'khor bar mi ldog lung yang bstan// rgyu 'bras rang la dgos med kyang*// gzugs sku'i sa bon gdab pa'i phyir// mi bden bzhin du rten 'brel sgrig /ces gsungs pas/ snying po don gyi gter mdzod lhan thabs dang bcas nas legs par bsgrubs pa'o// mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi snying po'i don// lhan cig skyes pa gnyug pa'i ye shes de// 'gro ba kun gyi snying la gnas gyur kyang*// bla mas ma mtshon rtogs par mi 'gyur bas// cung zad tsam zhig gsal bar bkod pa 'di// ban ldom kun dga'i ming can bdag gis bgyis// chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma mnyes na// don la dgongs nas bzod pa dam par bzhes// de las byung ba'i dge ba gang mtshon des// 'gro kun lhan skyes ye shes rtogs gyur nas// gnyis med rdo rje ye shes thob par shog

/ces pa 'di ni 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i skyes sbyor gzhung la brten te/ man ngag thor bu pa rnams dang yid ches pa'i lung khungs sbyar nas/ 'dan bla ma bsam grub la sogs dad ldan 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor dang*/ rang re'i 'bri gung pa'i chos mdzod dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir du/ skyes stobs blo yi 'byor ldan spyan snga ā nan+da rat+nas/ 'bri gung 'og min gyi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba 'dis/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde rgya chen po thogs par gyur cig /
// dge legs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ//
